text: 只有把理论与实践结合起来，我们才能真正理解这句话。
answer: Only when we combine theory with practice can we truly understand this sentence.
note: Only when 置句首，主句用 can we 倒装。

text: 面对如此多的信息，学生很难判断哪些是可靠的。
answer: Faced with so much information, students find it hard to judge which sources are reliable.
note: Faced with 作状语，逻辑主语为 students；which 引导宾语从句。

text: 正是那次失败让他意识到坚持的重要。
answer: It was that failure that made him realise the importance of persistence.
note: 强调主语 that failure，用 It was ... that ...。

text: 重要的不是记住多少，而是能运用多少。
answer: What matters is not how much you memorise but how much you can apply.
note: What 引导主语从句，is 后为表语从句。

text: 直到失去机会，他才意识到练习的价值。
answer: Not until he lost the chance did he realise the value of practice.
note: Not until 置句首，主句部分倒装。

text: 那些坚持每天复习的人，最终往往走得更远。
answer: Those who keep reviewing every day tend to go further in the end.
note: who 引导定语从句修饰 those。

text: What matters is not how much you memorise, but how well you can apply it.
answer: 重要的不是记住多少，而是能多好地运用它。
note: What 从句作主语；not ... but ... 对比。

text: Not until he lost the chance did he realise the value of practice.
answer: 直到失去机会，他才意识到练习的价值。
note: Not until 句首引起部分倒装。

text: Faced with so much information, students find it hard to judge which sources are reliable.
answer: 面对如此多的信息，学生很难判断哪些来源是可靠的。
note: Faced with 为过去分词作状语。

text: Those who keep reviewing every day tend to go further in the end.
answer: 那些每天坚持复习的人，最终往往走得更远。
note: who 引导定语从句。

text: 如果那天他多练了一遍，比赛结果可能就不同了。
answer: If he had practised once more that day, the result might have been different.
note: 与过去事实相反：从句 had done，主句 might have done。

text: 他迟到的消息让大家都很意外。
answer: The news that he was late surprised everyone.
note: that 从句说明 news 的具体内容，不作成分。

text: 你练得越多，进步就越快。
answer: The more you practise, the faster you will improve.
note: 两个分句都用陈述语序，只把比较级提前。

text: 虽然这道题很难，他还是独立做出来了。
answer: Although the problem was difficult, he worked it out on his own.
note: although 引导让步从句，主句不再用 but。

text: 要不是你提醒，我就错过截止日期了。
answer: But for your reminder, I would have missed the deadline.
note: But for 表示与过去事实相反的含蓄条件。

text: If I had known the rule earlier, I would not have made that mistake.
answer: 如果我早点知道这条规则，就不会犯那个错误了。
note: 与过去事实相反：had known / would not have made。

text: The idea that practice matters more than talent is widely accepted.
answer: 练习比天赋更重要这一观点已被广泛接受。
note: that 从句说明 idea 的具体内容。

text: The earlier you start, the more time you will have to revise.
answer: 你开始得越早，用来复习的时间就越多。
note: the + 比较级, the + 比较级；两个分句均用陈述语序。

text: No matter how hard the task is, she refuses to give up.
answer: 无论任务多难，她都不肯放弃。
note: no matter how 引导让步从句，后接形容词。

text: Although the plan failed, the team learned a great deal from it.
answer: 虽然计划失败了，团队从中学到了很多。
note: although 从句与主句之间不用 but。
